notes: Validator is documentation-based: parses validation/reports/rustre-analysis-vsa.md and emits the documented public surface (modules + lib.rs key symbols) to validation/out/rustre-analysis-vsa.json.

No MCP tool currently exposes the rustre-analysis-vsa surface (run_vsa, resolve_jump_table, resolve_indirect_calls, detect_buffer_overflows, query_point, TaintAnalyzer). This is explicitly recorded in the report's 'Gap' section and not a code defect.

Closest existing MCP tools (rustre-mcp) only consume related analyses indirectly: analysis_trace_data_flow_path, analysis_xref_call_graph*, analysis_recover_structs_path, analysis_infer_types_path, analysis_fn_cfg_path, decompiler_stack_frame_report, noreturn_infer.
